from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid separator rows and columns divide the grid into equal-sized cells.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    sep = grid[sep_rows[0]][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    cells_r = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    cells_c = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
    ch, cw = cells_r[0][1] - cells_r[0][0], cells_c[0][1] - cells_c[0][0]

    # Read the nonzero design from the sole non-left cell containing a design.
    design = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(cells_r):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cells_c):
            if ci == 0:
                continue
            pts = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep)]
            if pts:
                design = [(dr, dc) for dr, dc, _ in pts]
                break
        if design:
            break

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(cells_r):
        # Color is encoded by the marker in the first cell of each cell-row.
        marker_colors = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(cells_c[0][0], cells_c[0][1]) if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep)]
        color = marker_colors[0]
        for c0, c1 in cells_c:
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = 0
            for dr, dc in design:
                out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-92a4c597.py'
